color_swatch.name: prestige_accent_swatch
color_swatch.tool_tip: Accent: highlights, focus outlines, links, hovered and pressed items, emphasis and mention colours. Changes show right away. (Off while High contrast is on.)

color_swatch.name: prestige_window_swatch
color_swatch.tool_tip: Window background: windows, panels, menus and bars; text fields, borders and selected rows follow it. Changes show right away. (Off while High contrast is on.)

color_swatch.name: prestige_text_swatch
color_swatch.tool_tip: Text: labels, buttons, menus and chat text; dimmed and disabled text follow it. Changes show right away. (Off while High contrast is on.)

button.label: Reset to Prestige defaults
button.name: prestige_reset_colors
button.tool_tip: Use the skin's own accent, window and text colours again. Images drawn by the skin (active tabs, check boxes, slider knobs) always keep the skin's colours; pick a coloured skin above for those.
